entries.name: tree_autumn
entries.what: round autumn tree with a golden-yellow crown
entries.seen: a round deciduous tree seen from the front in three-quarter view: a dense golden-yellow crown built of leaf clusters shading to orange and dark olive in the shadows, a short dark trunk at its foot, lit from the upper left; the rectangle around it carries grass, a path and the edges of neighbouring orange trees
entries.confirmed_by: run operator, experiment of 2026-10-21 (owner confirmation pending)
entries.detail: leaf clusters in five to seven yellows and oranges with cool olive shadows underneath each cluster, a few single red leaves, the trunk in dark browns with a lit edge, a thin shadow at the foot

entries.name: stone_bridge
entries.what: arched stone footbridge with two arches and a cobbled walkway
entries.seen: a stone footbridge seen from the front-left in three-quarter view crossing a stream: two round arches of pink and tan stone blocks, a low parapet of rounded stones along both edges, a cobbled walkway of warm tan and orange flagstones, each stone a different warm shade with a lit top, lit from the upper left; the rectangle carries water, grass and a small figure on the bridge that is not part of it
entries.confirmed_by: run operator, experiment of 2026-10-21 (owner confirmation pending)
entries.detail: the parapet stones each in two or three pinks and tans with a lit top and a dark seam, the two arches with visible blocks and a dark underside, the walkway in eight to ten warm flagstone shades, a few moss patches at the water line, no figure, no water

entries.name: bench
entries.seen: a low wooden bench seen from the front-left: a plank seat on two dark wooden legs, warm mid-brown wood with a lit top edge and a darker underside, lit from the upper left; the rectangle carries grass, a basket and part of a seated figure that are not part of the bench
entries.confirmed_by: run operator, experiment of 2026-10-21 (owner confirmation pending)
entries.detail: plank grain in three browns, a lit top edge, a dark shadow under the seat, two legs with a darker inner face, no figure, no basket

entries.name: signpost
entries.what: wooden signpost holding a small framed painting
entries.seen: a wooden post with a small framed picture mounted on it, seen from the front: a dark brown post, a light wooden frame around a tiny landscape painting in greens and blues, a small plank roof above the frame, lit from the upper left; the rectangle carries grass and red autumn leaves behind it
entries.confirmed_by: run operator, experiment of 2026-10-21 (owner confirmation pending)
entries.detail: the post in three browns with grain, the frame lighter with a lit edge, the painting as a tiny landscape in four or five greens and blues, the plank roof with a shadow under it, no leaves behind

entries.name: mushrooms
entries.what: cluster of three small pale mushrooms
entries.seen: three small mushrooms close together on grass, seen from the front: pale cream caps with a warm tan top and a lit rim, thin pale stems, soft shadow under each cap, lit from the upper left; the rectangle is mostly grass
entries.confirmed_by: run operator, experiment of 2026-10-21 (owner confirmation pending)
entries.detail: each cap in three creams and tans with a lit rim and a darker underside, stems in two pales, a small shadow on the ground, no grass
